title: Requesting a New Lab Bench

prompt.scenario: You are a student in Dr. Ortega's chemistry laboratory. Your assigned workbench is located next to a leaking sink, and water has reached the electrical power outlets twice this week. Write an email to Dr. Ortega regarding this safety issue.
requirements: Explain why the wet bench is hazardous to students and ongoing experiments.
Describe the immediate precautions your team took to safeguard the samples.
Request permission to relocate to an unused bench and schedule a brief inspection.

modelEssay:
Dear Dr. Ortega,

I am writing to inform you of an urgent safety issue at our assigned laboratory bench. The adjacent sink has been leaking continuously, and water has already reached the electrical outlets on two occasions. This poses a serious risk of electrical shock and could damage the instruments we need for this week's experiment.

To prevent contamination, my team has temporarily relocated all chemical samples to a dry storage cabinet. Could we please move to the vacant workbench near the window until maintenance fixes the leak? I would also appreciate it if you could briefly inspect the area after Tuesday's lab.

Thank you for your time and support.

Sincerely,
Alex Morgan

Dear Ms. Vale,

Sincerely,
Alex Morgan

title: Seeking Feedback on a Research Question

prompt.scenario: You are a marine biology undergraduate drafting a research proposal in Dr. Yates's coastal ecology seminar. modelEssay:
Dear Dr. Yates,

I am writing to ask for your feedback on my revised research question for our marine coastal ecology proposal.

During our individual conference last week, you rightly noted that my original topic on industrial ocean pollution was far too broad for a one-semester undergraduate project. Taking your advice, I have narrowed my focus specifically to local waters. My revised research question is: "How do microplastic concentrations in intertidal oyster beds correlate with proximity to the municipal stormwater outfall in North Bay?" This targeted scope will allow me to sample manageable sediment volumes and complete data collection within eight weeks. Could you let me know if this refined question is viable? I would love to discuss it briefly during your Tuesday office hours. Thank you for your guidance.

Sincerely,
Alex Morgan
